newsitem.title: USA: Legato to give UNIX support to EDS.
newsitem.headline: Legato to give UNIX support to EDS.

text.p: Legato Systems Inc said on Monday it has been selected to support the UNIX storage management requirements of Electronic Data System's Client/Server Technology Centers and Renascence Centers.

Legato NetWorker for UNIX would support centers where EDS demonstrates its technology, including integrated services for planning, deploying and operating distributed client/server resources in a global business, Legato said in a statement.
Legato shares were up 2-1/2 at 44-1/2 and EDS shares were unchanged at 54-7/8.
EDS's Renascence Centers are distributed systems management facilities.

Legato NetWorker for UNIX would meet stringent, corporate-wide data protection and disaster recovery mandates, Legato said. It would also be used for backing up Windows and Windows 95 demonstration machines in the EDS Centers.
The solution would also provide an equivalent degree of protection for a virtually unlimited number of EDS customers -- regardless of platform, Legato said.
Legato develops, markets and supports network storage management software products for client/server computing environments.
EDS is an enterprise storage management software company.
